landing.heroTitle: The AI coding workflow that remembers
landing.heroSubtitle: Turn ideas into shipped work with structured stages, an AI agent that plans and implements, and a knowledge base that compounds with every release.

showcase.title: Your whole flow on one screen
showcase.subtitle: Sprint health, flow metrics, and team activity — the dashboard that keeps every stage of your pipeline in view.

landing.pipelineTitle: One structured flow, from idea to shipped
landing.pipelineSubtitle: Every task moves through the same stages, so nothing falls through the cracks and every decision leaves a trail.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to ship with confidence
landing.featuresSubtitle: A complete workflow for teams that want structure without the ceremony.

flows.title: Structured Flows
flows.desc: A 7-stage pipeline — Idea, Planning, Approval, Ready, In Progress, Review, Done — with acceptance criteria and an automatic audit trail.
flows.b2: Automatic audit trail of every change
flows.b3: Auto transitions when work moves forward

ai.title: AI Agent Integration
ai.desc: An AI agent that plans work and writes the code, gated by your knowledge. Toggle self-approval on for a fully autonomous flow.
ai.b3: REST API + webhooks for your tools

wiki.title: Compounding LLM-Wiki
wiki.desc: ADRs, patterns, and runbooks captured automatically as work ships. Your team's knowledge compounds instead of evaporating.
wiki.b2: Drift warnings when code moves on
wiki.b3: The Iron Law: anything shipped is documented

kanban.title: Visual Kanban Board
kanban.desc: Drag tasks across columns with live presence, sprint planning, and effortless dependency mapping.

orgs.title: Organizations & Teams
orgs.desc: Workspaces and roles scale from a solo project to a full organization — invitations, permissions, and audit all built in.

releases.title: Release Management
releases.desc: Track what ships when. Epics, milestones, and reports keep the whole team aligned on delivery.

landing.howSubtitle: From idea to shipped in three steps.

step1.label: STEP 01
step1.title: Create a Flow
step1.desc: Set up a project, invite your team, and define the stages your work moves through.

step2.label: STEP 02
step2.title: AI Plans & Implements
step2.desc: The agent turns approved ideas into tasks and code, learning from your team's documented patterns.

step3.label: STEP 03
step3.title: Review & Ship
step3.desc: Human review at every gate, then ship with confidence — and watch your wiki grow with every release.

landing.ctaSubtitle: Set up your first flow in minutes — free, no credit card required.

flow.overview: Implement OAuth 2.0 refresh flow. Token rotation, silent refresh on 401, retry with exponential backoff.
flow.aiPlanDesc: Refactor auth module: add refresh interceptor, rotation logic, and store migration.

intel.title: Old entries don't die — they vote with weight.
intel.desc: When the agent plans, the wiki replies as a chorus: every entry contributes proportionally to its relevance. Foundational ADRs answer loud. Deprecated ones whisper a warning. Superseded ones forward to their successor. The agent gets a state-aware context bundle — not just a search result.
intel.acceptedDesc: full weight — the law of the codebase
intel.deprecatedDesc: still heard — surfaces as a warning
intel.terminalContextBundle: Context bundle returned to agent · sorted by weight
